definitions.explanation: The joint connecting the hand to the arm. Literally 'hand neck.'

examples.japanese: {手首|てくび}を{回|まわ}してください。
{手首|てくび}に{時計|とけい}をしています。
examples.english: I'm wearing a watch on my wrist.

examples.japanese: {転|ころ}んで{手首|てくび}を{痛|いた}めてしまいました。
examples.english: I fell and hurt my wrist.

examples.japanese: パソコンを{使|つか}いすぎて{手首|てくび}が{痛|いた}くなりました。{少|すこ}し{休|やす}んだ{方|ほう}がいいですね。
examples.english: My wrist hurts from using the computer too much. I should rest a bit.

notes:
{手首|てくび} (wrist) literally means 'hand-neck,' using the body part naming pattern where {首|くび} indicates a joint.

WORD FORMATION:
{手|て} (hand) + {首|くび} (neck/joint) = wrist

SIMILAR BODY PARTS:
- {足首|あしくび}: ankle (foot-neck)
- {手首|てくび}: wrist (hand-neck)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {手首|てくび}が{痛|いた}い: my wrist hurts
- {手首|てくび}を{回|まわ}す: to rotate the wrist
- {手首|てくび}を{痛|いた}める: to injure one's wrist
- {手首|てくび}に{時計|とけい}をする: to wear a watch on one's wrist

MEDICAL:
- {脈|みゃく}を{取|と}る: to take someone's pulse (often at the wrist)
- {手首|てくび}の{骨折|こっせつ}: wrist fracture
